answer: Resist sybils with a velvet rope that costs money to cross: every new agent identity must burn a small fee and wait seven days before its limits unlock, growing only with honest history. A whisper of bad behavior from peers freezes the account during review. One identity is cheap, but a thousand fake ones burn a thousand fees and a thousand weeks of waiting - the swarm cracks like a walnut against the shell of time and cost, while honest agents barely notice the rope.
